title: I made the last smoking room in the world with Fable 5.2. Everyone has to wait in line.
author: Vegetable-Cod-5098
selftext:
There's one smoking room left. It fits 30 people and you get three minutes. Everyone else is in the same line, and it winds around the city.



While you wait you can stomp, sigh, check your watch, shake your fist, or say something to the people around you. Or give up and walk away. Every quit counts toward the city's not-smoked tally.



[https://nosmoking.city](https://nosmoking.city)



Made with Claude Code in about half a day. Fable 5.2 wrote the Blender Python scripts for every model, Opus 5.5 wrote the game and the server.



The whole line runs in one Node process, so everyone is in the same queue. When only a few people are playing, bots fill it up to around 1,700. They only join at the back, so they never push a real person further from the door. In the end they're there for the same reason as the line itself, to keep that cigarette a little further away.



Has anyone else gone the scripts route for art instead of image to 3D tools? Curious where it broke down for you.

replies.author: Vegetable-Cod-5098
replies.body: It's a quit smoking game in disguise. If waiting two hours for one cigarette sounds ridiculous, that's kind of the point.
